title: Add Storybook with happy-path stories for all components
story: As a developer, I want Storybook set up with a story for each component so that I can verify components look and work as expected without going through the full app flow
acceptance_criteria: Storybook is installed and configured for the project
README documents the command for running Storybook
One happy-path story exists for each component: Timer, Editor, HighlightedText, Results, Score, ApiKeyForm, Exercise
Each story renders its component without errors
out_of_scope: Error states or multiple stories per component
user_retro: Acceptance criteria should have included automated tests that verify each story renders without error.
